title: Truly Horrorified
description: A horror modpack that will make you scared.
body:
Truly Horrorified completely strips away the safety nets of vanilla Minecraft, turning a casual sandbox into a stressful, pitch-black hunt.

Instead of dealing with boring waves of regular zombies, you're dealing with psychological tension, things that stalk you from the dark, and a sound overhaul that makes every single step you take a massive liability.

## Warnings
- Epilepsy Notice: This pack includes sudden visual disruptions, screen flashing, flickering light sources, and intense visual distortion effects during specific events or encounters. If you are sensitive to flashing lights or have a history of seizures, please exercise extreme caution or adjust your settings accordingly before playing.

- Hardware Notice: This pack is not meant for weak PCs. Even with heavy performance optimization built right in to keep things stable, the heavy pathfinding, realistic audio physics, and detailed weapon systems mean you need a capable computer to run this smoothly.

## Features
- The Stalking Shadows: The things hunting you aren't stupid. They don't just blindly rush your face; they watch you from the tree lines, break your torches, trail behind you in deep caves, and wait for the absolute worst moment to strike.

- Acoustic Vulnerability: Sound actually travels and echoes through walls and cave networks. Monsters will hear you walking, opening chests, and breaking blocks, turning a routine mining trip into an accidental dinner bell.

- Tactical Gunplay: You have access to firearms and tight combat mechanics to defend yourself. But ammo is incredibly scarce. Every time you pull the trigger, you have to decide right then and there if fighting is worth the noise, or if you should just run.

- Total Visual Blackout: Nighttime and deep caves are an absolute void. You cannot see anything without a physical light source in your hand or on the ground, and the ambient audio completely distorts the closer you get to danger.

- For more of an effect, turn off your lights, use headphones, play at night, and play in fullscreen and turn off all other monitors. (If you have other monitors)
